SELECT * FROM tick_data FINAL
WHERE symbol = %(symbol)s
AND exchange = %(exchange)s
AND datetime >= toDateTime64(%(start)s, 3, %(timezone)s)
AND datetime <= toDateTime64(%(end)s, 3, %(timezone)s)
ORDER BY datetime ASC
